# AI Change Log

> A dated log of AI tools that shut down, changed price, changed usage limits, deprecated a model or changed licensing policy. Each entry lists the vendor, the change type, the status (confirmed vs reported), the deadline if any, and the migration step.

Last updated: 2026-11-16. Entries are re-checked against vendor documentation; the status field distinguishes confirmed changes from press reports.

## Changes
- [A banked Codex reset was activated for all paid users on November 12, 2026](https://changes.aigeolens.com/change/codex-banked-reset-nov-12-2026.html): confirmed, 2026-11-12, affects Developers
- [Google's November 2026 core update is rolling out — global, all languages, up to two weeks](https://changes.aigeolens.com/change/google-november-2026-core-update.html): confirmed, 2026-11-10, affects Site owners · Marketers
- [Google Custom Search JSON API is being shut down — migration options for site search and RAG](https://changes.aigeolens.com/change/google-custom-search-api-shutdown.html): reported, 2026-10-30, affects Developers
- [OpenAI doubled Codex and Work usage limits on Pro 100 and Pro 500, and cancelled the Pro 200 cut](https://changes.aigeolens.com/change/codex-pro-limits-doubled-oct-2026.html): confirmed, 2026-10-29, affects Developers · Teams & IT
- [Solo (Mozilla's AI website builder) is shutting down — sites deleted November 30, 2026](https://changes.aigeolens.com/change/solo-ai-website-builder-shutdown.html): confirmed, 2026-10-01, affects Site owners · Founders
- [Google's September 2026 spam update finished rolling out on October 8](https://changes.aigeolens.com/change/google-september-2026-spam-update.html): confirmed, 2026-09-24, affects Site owners · Marketers
- [Google's August 2026 spam update ran for three days and completed August 21](https://changes.aigeolens.com/change/google-august-2026-spam-update.html): confirmed, 2026-08-18, affects Site owners · Marketers
- [Gemini's latest models ignore temperature, top_p and top_k](https://changes.aigeolens.com/change/gemini-temperature-top-p-top-k-deprecated.html): confirmed, 2026-07-21, affects Developers
- [Developers are pushing back on plans to discontinue Gemini 2.5 Flash](https://changes.aigeolens.com/change/gemini-2-5-flash-discontinuation-pressure.html): reported, 2026-07-10, affects Developers
- [Microsoft began cancelling internal Claude Code licenses](https://changes.aigeolens.com/change/microsoft-cancels-claude-code-licenses.html): reported, 2026-05-22, affects Teams & IT · Founders
- [OpenAI moved to discontinue Sora, its AI video product](https://changes.aigeolens.com/change/sora-discontinued-2026.html): reported, 2026-03-24, affects Marketers · Teams & IT
